creator: Thomas, Alaina; Duarte, Adam; Gostin, Matt; Peterson, James; Lesmeister, Damon
citation: Thomas, A., Duarte, A., Gostin, M., Peterson, J., & Lesmeister, D. (2025). Detection histories and covariates for marbled murrelet survey comparison [Dataset]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.17497184
geographicCoverage: Oregon, USA: study areas JCN, ODFN and ODFS (Oregon Department of Forestry state forests; no station coordinates deposited)
title: Marbled murrelet daily passive acoustic detections at 69 inland stations in two years, Oregon, 2022-2023
abstract: Passive acoustic monitoring (PAM) and audio-visual (AV) surveys for marbled murrelets at inland stations in three study areas on the Oregon coast in 2022 and 2023, deposited as one encounter-history matrix to compare the two methods' cost and detection. eco ships the two methods as two tables because their surveys were on different days.
samplingProtocol: Autonomous recording units at inland forest stations; each recorded day is a survey with a detection (1) or not (0) of marbled murrelet calls, as deposited.
closureNote: Daily acoustic surveys over up to 53 days per station-year in the breeding season; station use may change over that span. Same stations as the audio-visual table (thomas_2025_oregon_murrelet_av_occ).
covariateNote: unit_study_area: JCN, ODFN or ODFS. obs_temp_c: temperature (degrees C) of the survey. obs_noise_dbfs: background noise (dBFS) of the survey, as deposited (blank on 19 AV visits).

notShipped.stray_temperature: 4 temperature values in cells with no survey (no detection, date or survey type)
notShipped.other_method: the other method's surveys are in thomas_2025_oregon_murrelet_av_occ
notShipped.model_output: the paper's occupancy and detection estimates

notes: Companion table: thomas_2025_oregon_murrelet_av_occ (same stations, other method). Station identity across years from the station id without its year suffix.
